record.paper_title: Some open problems in dynamical systems
record.original_question: Can the characteristic flow on a smooth compact connected hypersurface M^{2n−1} ⊂ R^{2n} be an Anosov flow?

evidence.quote: 2. Can the characteristic ﬂow on M 2n−1 be an Anosov ﬂow ?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $\omega = \sum_{i=1}^{n} dx_i \wedge dy_i$ be the standard symplectic form on $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$, and let $M \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ be a smooth, compact, connected hypersurface of dimension $2n-1$. At every point $p \in M$, the restriction $\omega|_{T_pM}$ has a one-dimensional kernel $\ell_p \subset T_pM$ (since $\omega$ is non-degenerate and $T_pM$ has codimension one in $T_p\mathbb{R}^{2n}$). The line field $p \mapsto \ell_p$ is smooth and integrates to a smooth one-dimensional foliation of $M$, which (after a choice of nowhere-vanishing section) defines the characteristic flow on $M$. Recall that a smooth flow $\varphi_t$ on a compact manifold $N$ generated by a nowhere-vanishing vector field $X$ is called Anosov if there exists a continuous $D\varphi_t$-invariant splitting $TN = E^s \oplus \mathbb{R}X \oplus E^u$ together with constants $C>0$ and $0<\lambda<1$ such that $\|D\varphi_t v\| \le C\lambda^t \|v\|$ for all $v \in E^s$ and $t \ge 0$, and $\|D\varphi_{-t} v\| \le C\lambda^t \|v\|$ for all $v \in E^u$ and $t \ge 0$ (with respect to some Riemannian metric on $N$). Question: does there exist a smooth, compact, connected hypersurface $M^{2n-1} \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ (for some $n \ge 2$) whose characteristic flow is an Anosov flow?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches reveal active research connecting characteristic foliations of hypersurfaces in symplectic manifolds, contact topology, and Anosov dynamics (e.g., rigidity results for Anosov optical hypersurfaces in cotangent bundles, and constructions of robustly non-convex hypersurfaces). However, no source found explicitly settles whether a smooth compact connected hypersurface of $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ can carry an Anosov characteristic flow; the question appears to remain open in this specific (standard symplectic Euclidean) setting.

status_evidence.title: Rigidity properties of Anosov optical hypersurfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies optical hypersurfaces with Anosov characteristic foliations in cotangent bundles with twisted symplectic structures, proving rigidity results.
status_evidence.claim: Anosov characteristic foliations are studied in related (cotangent bundle) settings, but the Euclidean hypersurface case is not resolved here.

status_evidence.title: Robustly Non-Convex Hypersurfaces In Contact Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs hypersurfaces in contact manifolds with C^2-robustly transitive characteristic foliations.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research constructs interesting characteristic foliations, indicating the topic remains under investigation.

status_evidence.title: A symplectic viewpoint on Anosov flows
status_evidence.snippet: Recent survey of the interface between symplectic geometry and Anosov flows.
status_evidence.claim: The relationship between Anosov dynamics and characteristic/contact-type flows is an actively developing area.
